title: Q3 unbounded multiplication-norm boundary and energy-weighted target
question: Does the actual Q3 source admit a finite ordinary multiplication-operator norm on an unbounded field line, or must the QFT route use an energy-weighted/domain seminorm?

finite_fixture.interpretation: On the full real field line, multiplication by P_0 is not bounded in ordinary L2 operator norm; the finite values are only a reproducible witness of the growth mechanism.
